steps.title: Draw the center
steps.instruction: A snowflake grows from its middle. Draw a small circle in the center of your page.

steps.title: Draw the top arm
steps.instruction: The first arm points up. Up one side, out and back for a branch, over the tip, then down the same way.

steps.title: Draw the upper right arm
steps.instruction: The next arm leans to the upper right. It is the same shape, just turned.

steps.title: Draw the lower right arm
steps.instruction: Now the lower right arm. Side, branch, tip, branch, side.

steps.title: Draw the bottom arm
steps.instruction: The fourth arm points straight down, like the first one upside down.

steps.title: Draw the lower left arm
steps.instruction: Two arms to go. This one reaches to the lower left.

steps.title: Draw the upper left arm
steps.instruction: The last arm fills the gap on the upper left. Now there are six.

steps.title: Draw the diamonds
steps.instruction: Between the arms sit six little diamonds. Each is a tiny kite with soft corners.

steps.title: Color the arms
steps.instruction: Color the arms and the center light blue.
